ops.body: - [loop] On Chronicle's star sheet the existing outlined "Map" pill (a section switch that shows the place on the map) sits beside "Open in Maps ↗", and both say "Map" with a map-style glyph; the arrow is the only difference (open-in-maps-here UI review U1, Nov 17). Fix, if the owner wants it: a label for the section switch that says what it does ("Show on map"), or no glyph on it

- [loop] A tile's two half-width buttons were never checked at a 200% text size: their labels may wrap and are not truncated, but the tile's 52 px foot slot is fixed, so a very large size may crowd the footer above it (open-in-maps-here UI review U4, Nov 17; web cannot scale text, so device only). Fix: a device check, then a taller slot at large sizes
